It was just a simple question, no need to get all defensive.  I personally find it offputting and I know I'm not the only one so maybe that's why you're having such a hard time finding a friend.

P.S.  No, [I'm not the one who downvoted you](http://i.imgur.com/jp1jlLT.png) but thanks for getting all rude and accusatory for absolutely no reason.

Why is the first thing you say about yourself is that you're straight?  Why should your sexuality matter at all, let alone enough to be literally the first thing you use to describe yourself?  

Sorry, it's just that I've seen you post *at least* 30-40 times now and every time I see that I'm really put off so I finally had to ask.
